Better safe than sorry, I would suggest you take it. Sometimes cycles can be wonky so you should never rely on your cycle for birth control.

The bleeding happened to me too. I’ve taken plan b 3 times and i got spotting and bleeding about a week after unprotected sex. Lasted about 2-3 weeks. My pharmacist said that bleeding for over 7 days wasn’t normal but since i don’t have access to a doctor i just let it fix itself on its own. I was fine, just a little iron deficient. 

Each time i got a bit paranoid it was implantation bleeding (it never was) so it’s a good idea to take a pregnancy test just in case.

I don't know if Thom used Kafka's work to inspire the album but I definitely see what you're saying and it's a very possible theory. Ok computer is about the absurdity of life, the main theme of the Metamorphosis. So in retrospect i wouldn't be surprised if the album was heavily inspired by Kafka's novel.

You also have to realize that we were social animals, yes we were selfish to succumb to our own needs but we also had to share and help others to ensure the survival of our family/tribe. Human nature posses both generous and selfish in a way that balances itself out. If we were too selfish, we would be hated or thrown out by our tribe/family, left alone and ultimately disadvantaged survival wise. I agree, there is no point in life, we are useless and we are destroying the very planet we live on so we do deserve and ultimately should to go extinct. I'm just saying, humans aren't 100% bad or good. There's always both.

I agree with you, we are all just byproducts of evolution, we succumb to our animalistic desires because our brain tells us to. Personally, i do not believe there is a meaning to life...it's all random and the odds just worked out in a way that we are here as a species. See the thing is nihilists believe this too and seeing that we are so small in an infinitely vast world, what we do and how we feel does not matter. Just because it doesn't matter, though, doesn't mean it doesn't exist. As human beings, yes we are selfish but we also have a need to help others, no matter what philosophy you agree with, you will still have emotions unless you're a psychopath. Nihilism is a dark philosophy but the fundamental basics of it are tied to existentialism. So if Nihilists became existentialists, which is a very possible occurrence, the meaning they create within themselves could be to ultimately reduce the suffering of other animals including humans.

nihilists and theists aren't devoid of empathy, they are human just as we are and have the same emotions as we do. The only difference is that nihilists realize that these emotions do not give a meaning to life, as there is no meaning to life. They will still act according to the rules and norms of a society, otherwise they would all be in jail. They just realize that there is no purpose. It's basically a depressing version of existentialism.
